styles.controls:AnnotatedScrollBar:
<ns0:Style xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" TargetType="controls:AnnotatedScrollBar">
        <ns0:Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="{StaticResource LabelsGridMinWidth}" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="False" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="LabelTemplate">
            <ns0:Setter.Value>
                <ns0:DataTemplate>
                    <ns0:Border MinWidth="{StaticResource LabelsGridMinWidth}">
                        <ns0:TextBlock Margin="0,-5,0,-2" HorizontalAlignment="Right" HorizontalTextAlignment="Right" Style="{StaticResource BodyTextBlockStyle}" AutomationProperties.AccessibilityView="Raw" Text="{Binding Content}" TextWrapping="NoWrap" />
                    </ns0:Border>
                </ns0:DataTemplate>
            </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>
        <ns0:Setter Property="Template">
            <ns0:Setter.Value>
                <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="controls:AnnotatedScrollBar">
                    <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="PART_RootGrid" IsTapEnabled="True">
                        <ns0:Grid.RowDefinitions>
                            <ns0:RowDefinition Height="auto" />
                            <ns0:RowDefinition Height="*" />
                            <ns0:RowDefinition Height="auto" />
                        </ns0:Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <ns0:RepeatButton ns1:Name="PART_VerticalIncrementRepeatButton" Grid.Row="0" Style="{StaticResource ScrollButtonStyle}" AutomationProperties.AccessibilityView="Raw" HorizontalAlignment="Right" IsTabStop="False">
                            <ns0:FontIcon ns1:Name="PART_VerticalIncrementRepeatIcon" FontSize="{StaticResource ScrollButtonFontSize}" Glyph="" />
                        </ns0:RepeatButton>
                        <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="PART_VerticalGrid" Grid.Row="1">
                            <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="PART_LabelsGrid" Background="Transparent" HorizontalAlignment="Center" MinWidth="{StaticResource LabelsGridMinWidth}" />
                            <ns0:Border ns1:Name="PART_ToolTipRail" HorizontalAlignment="Right" Width="1">
                                <ns0:ToolTipService.ToolTip>
                                    <ns0:ToolTip ns1:Name="PART_DetailLabelToolTip" Placement="Top" MaxWidth="{StaticResource AnnotatedScrollBarTooltipMaxWidth}" MinHeight="{StaticResource AnnotatedScrollBarTooltipMinHeight}" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Right">
                                        <ns0:ContentPresenter ns1:Name="PART_TooltipContentPresenter">
                                            <ns0:ContentPresenter.ContentTemplate>
                                                <ns0:DataTemplate>
                                                    <ns0:Border>
                                                        <ns0:TextBlock Margin="0,0,0,2" HorizontalAlignment="Right" VerticalAlignment="Center" Style="{StaticResource BaseTextBlockStyle}" AutomationProperties.AccessibilityView="Raw" Text="{Binding}" TextWrapping="WrapWholeWords" />
                                                    </ns0:Border>
                                                </ns0:DataTemplate>
                                            </ns0:ContentPresenter.ContentTemplate>
                                        </ns0:ContentPresenter>
                                    </ns0:ToolTip>
                                </ns0:ToolTipService.ToolTip>
                            </ns0:Border>
                            <ns0:Border ns1:Name="PART_VerticalThumbGhost" Grid.Row="1" Visibility="Collapsed" Width="{StaticResource ThumbWidth}" Height="{StaticResource ThumbHeight}" CornerRadius="{StaticResource ThumbCornerRadius}" Background="{ThemeResource AccentFillColorDisabledBrush}" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Right" />
                            <ns0:Border ns1:Name="PART_VerticalThumb" Grid.Row="1" Width="{StaticResource ThumbWidth}" Height="{StaticResource ThumbHeight}" CornerRadius="{StaticResource ThumbCornerRadius}" Background="{ThemeResource VerticalThumbBrush}" VerticalAlignment="Top" HorizontalAlignment="Right" />

styles.controls:ItemContainer:
<ns0:Style xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" TargetType="controls:ItemContainer">
    <ns0:Setter Property="Background" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerBackground}" />
    <ns0:Setter Property="UseSystemFocusVisuals" Value="True" />
    <ns0:Setter Property="FocusVisualPrimaryThickness" Value="2" />
    <ns0:Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="{ThemeResource ControlCornerRadius}" />
    <ns0:Setter Property="Template">
      <ns0:Setter.Value>
        <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="controls:ItemContainer">
          <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="PART_ContainerRoot" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" CornerRadius="{TemplateBinding CornerRadius}">
            <ns0:VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
              <ns0:VisualStateGroup ns1:Name="CombinedStates">
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="UnselectedNormal" />
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="UnselectedPointerOver">
                  <ns0:Storyboard>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Fill">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerPointerOverBackground}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Stroke">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerPointerOverBorderBrush}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                  </ns0:Storyboard>
                </ns0:VisualState>
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="UnselectedPressed">
                  <ns0:Storyboard>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Fill">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerPressedBackground}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Stroke">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerPressedBorderBrush}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                  </ns0:Storyboard>
                </ns0:VisualState>
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="SelectedNormal">
                  <ns0:Storyboard>
                    <ns0:DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetName="PART_SelectionVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity" Duration="0" To="1" />
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_SelectionVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="BorderBrush">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectionVisualBackground}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Fill">
                        <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedBackground}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Stroke">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedInnerBorderBrush}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Margin">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedInnerMargin}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                  </ns0:Storyboard>
                </ns0:VisualState>
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="SelectedPointerOver">
                  <ns0:Storyboard>
                    <ns0:DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_SelectionVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity">
                      <ns0:SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ControlFastAnimationDuration}" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1" />
                    </ns0:DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Fill">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedPointerOverBackground}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_SelectionVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="BorderBrush">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectionVisualPointerOverBackground}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Stroke">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedInnerBorderBrush}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Margin">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedInnerMargin}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                  </ns0:Storyboard>
                </ns0:VisualState>
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="SelectedPressed">
                  <ns0:Storyboard>
                    <ns0:DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_SelectionVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity">
                      <ns0:SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ControlFastAnimationDuration}" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1" />
                    </ns0:DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Fill">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedPressedBackground}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_SelectionVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="BorderBrush">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectionVisualPressedBackground}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Stroke">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedInnerBorderBrush}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_CommonVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Margin">
                      <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedInnerMargin}" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                  </ns0:Storyboard>
                </ns0:VisualState>
              </ns0:VisualStateGroup>
              <ns0:VisualStateGroup ns1:Name="MultiSelectStates">
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="Single" />
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="Multiple">
                  <ns0:Storyboard>
                    <ns0:DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_SelectionCheckbox" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity">
                      <ns0:SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ControlFastAnimationDuration}" Value="1" KeySpline="0,0,0,1" />
                    </ns0:DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                  </ns0:Storyboard>
                </ns0:VisualState>
              </ns0:VisualStateGroup>
              <ns0:VisualStateGroup ns1:Name="DisabledStates">
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="Enabled" />
                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="Disabled">
                  <ns0:Storyboard>
                    <ns0:DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_ContainerRoot" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity">
                      <ns0:SplineDoubleKeyFrame KeyTime="{StaticResource ControlFastAnimationDuration}" Value="{StaticResource ItemContainerDisabledOpacity}" KeySpline="0,0,0,1" />
                    </ns0:DoubleAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                    <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="PART_SelectionVisual" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Visibility">
                        <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="Collapsed" />
                    </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                  </ns0:Storyboard>
                </ns0:VisualState>
              </ns0:VisualStateGroup>
            </ns0:VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
            
            <ns0:Grid ns1:Name="PART_SelectionVisual" ns1:DeferLoadStrategy="Lazy" BorderBrush="Transparent" BorderThickness="3" Background="Transparent" CornerRadius="{TemplateBinding CornerRadius}" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" VerticalAlignment="Stretch" IsHitTestVisible="False" Opacity="0" />
            <ns0:Rectangle ns1:Name="PART_CommonVisual" Stroke="{ThemeResource ItemContainerBorderBrush}" StrokeThickness="{ThemeResource ItemContainerSelectedInnerThickness}" HorizontalAlignment="Stretch" VerticalAlignment="Stretch" IsHitTestVisible="False" RadiusX="{Binding CornerRadius, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}, Converter={StaticResource TopLeftCornerRadiusDoubleValueConverter}}" RadiusY="{Binding CornerRadius, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}, Converter={StaticResource BottomRightCornerRadiusDoubleValueConverter}}" />
            <ns0:CheckBox ns1:Name="PART_SelectionCheckbox" Style="{StaticResource ItemContainerSelectionCheckboxStyle}" ns1:DeferLoadStrategy="Lazy" Opacity="0">
                 <ns0:CheckBox.Resources>
                     <ns0:StaticResource ns1:Key="CheckBoxCheckBackgroundFillUnchecked" ResourceKey="ControlOnImageFillColorDefaultBrush" />
                 </ns0:CheckBox.Resources>
             </ns0:CheckBox>
          </ns0:Grid>
        </ns0:ControlTemplate>
      </ns0:Setter.Value>
    </ns0:Setter>
  </ns0:Style>
styles.ItemContainerSelectionCheckboxStyle:
<ns0:Style xmlns:ns0="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation" xmlns:ns1="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml" xmlns:ns2="using:Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls" xmlns:ns3="using:Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Controls.AnimatedVisuals" ns1:Key="ItemContainerSelectionCheckboxStyle" TargetType="CheckBox">
        <ns0:Setter Property="Margin" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerCheckboxMargin}" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerCheckboxMinWidth}" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerCheckboxHorizontalAlignment}" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="VerticalAlignment" Value="{ThemeResource ItemContainerCheckboxVerticalAlignment}" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="IsHitTestVisible" Value="False" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="False" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="AutomationProperties.AccessibilityView" Value="Raw" />
        <ns0:Setter Property="Template">
            <ns0:Setter.Value>
                <ns0:ControlTemplate TargetType="CheckBox">
                    <ns0:Border ns1:Name="RootBorder" Background="{ThemeResource ItemContainerCheckboxBackgroundUnchecked}" BorderBrush="{ThemeResource CheckBoxCheckBackgroundStrokeUnchecked}" BorderThickness="{ThemeResource CheckBoxBorderThickness}" CornerRadius="{ThemeResource ControlCornerRadius}" Width="{ThemeResource CheckBoxSize}" Height="{ThemeResource CheckBoxSize}">
                        <ns0:VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                            <ns0:VisualStateGroup ns1:Name="CombinedStates">
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="UncheckedNormal" />
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="UncheckedPointerOver" />
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="UncheckedPressed" />
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="UncheckedDisabled">
                                    <ns0:Storyboard>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="RootBorder" Storyboard.TargetProperty="BorderBrush">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource CheckBoxCheckBackgroundStrokeUncheckedDisabled}" />
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="RootBorder" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Background">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource CheckBoxCheckBackgroundFillUncheckedDisabled}" />
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="CheckGlyph" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Foreground">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource CheckBoxCheckGlyphForegroundUncheckedDisabled}" />
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </ns0:Storyboard>
                                    <ns0:VisualState.Setters>
                                        <ns0:Setter Target="CheckGlyph.(controls:AnimatedIcon.State)" Value="NormalOff" />
                                    </ns0:VisualState.Setters>
                                </ns0:VisualState>
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="CheckedNormal">
                                    <ns0:Storyboard>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="RootBorder" Storyboard.TargetProperty="BorderBrush">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource CheckBoxCheckBackgroundStrokeChecked}" />
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="RootBorder" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Background">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource CheckBoxCheckBackgroundFillChecked}" />
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                        <ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames Storyboard.TargetName="CheckGlyph" Storyboard.TargetProperty="Foreground">
                                            <ns0:DiscreteObjectKeyFrame KeyTime="0" Value="{ThemeResource CheckBoxCheckGlyphForegroundChecked}" />
                                        </ns0:ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames>
                                    </ns0:Storyboard>
                                    <ns0:VisualState.Setters>
                                        <ns0:Setter Target="CheckGlyph.(controls:AnimatedIcon.State)" Value="NormalOn" />
                                    </ns0:VisualState.Setters>
                                </ns0:VisualState>
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="CheckedPointerOver" />
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="CheckedPressed" />
                                <ns0:VisualState ns1:Name="CheckedDisabled" />
                            </ns0:VisualStateGroup>
                        </ns0:VisualStateManager.VisualStateGroups>
                        
                        <ns2:AnimatedIcon ns1:Name="CheckGlyph" Foreground="{ThemeResource CheckBoxCheckGlyphForegroundUnchecked}" Margin="0,1,0,-1" State="NormalOff">
                            <ns3:AnimatedAcceptVisualSource />
                            <ns2:AnimatedIcon.FallbackIconSource>
                                <ns2:FontIconSource ns1:Name="DownLevelCheckGlyph" FontFamily="{ThemeResource SymbolThemeFontFamily}" Glyph="{StaticResource CheckBoxCheckedGlyph}" FontSize="{StaticResource CheckBoxGlyphSize}" />
                            </ns2:AnimatedIcon.FallbackIconSource>
                        </ns2:AnimatedIcon>
                    </ns0:Border>
                </ns0:ControlTemplate>
            </ns0:Setter.Value>
        </ns0:Setter>
    </ns0:Style>

            </ns0:StackPanel>
          </ns0:Grid>
        </ns0:ControlTemplate>
      </ns0:Setter.Value>
    </ns0:Setter>
